listing.name: Aliceworks Hull Mods
listing.summary: Adds new hull mods with unique trade-offs in armor, crew survivability, and system performance.
listing.aiSummary: Adds new hull mods with unique trade-offs in armor, crew survivability, and system performance.

description:
Hello.  I am new to modding on starsector and made some new hull mods to test.  I am new to Java as well so please be patient and do not add if you have a save game already.

Here are the null hull mods and what they do

Right now, these hull mods only work with base stats, and do not work if you add hull mods to increase them.  The reason is I can't code it properly to work how I wanted it to and also these hull mods are meant to be used on weird ships not all ships.

Bolstered Bulkheads

An expensive internal refit that strips out crew bunks and living fittings to layer the hull with armoured compartmentalisation. The result is a dramatically tougher frame that absorbs and reduces incoming hull damage. The same reinforcement gives the crew far better odds when the ship takes fire, cutting casualties and increasing life support, and is far easier to recover if lost in battle. Designed for VIP transports where survival is paramount, permanent installation hardens the hull and increases the ship's base armor, and is always recoverable. Incompatible with Advanced Armor and Reinforced Bulkheads.

Desperate Measures

A last-ditch refit that strips out the shield generators and related systems, freeing up power and space (represented as OP) for other critical systems. This is a one-way trip; once removed, the shields are gone for good. Not an option for phase vessels or ships that already lack shielding.

Dream Drive Field

This experimental drive converts crew emotional resonance into raw propulsion, granting exceptional drive acceleration, reduced fuel consumption, and lower minimum crew requirements. The tradeoff is severe: crew casualties mount rapidly in any sustained engagement, hull repairs and system recovery slow dramatically, and deployment costs increase due to the drive's complex operation. Only a disciplined crew can endure the field's psychological and operational demands. Incompatible with Augmented Drive Field and Efficiency Overhaul.

Retrofit Flight Deck

For captains who value air power over freight, this extensive modification carves fighter bays directly into the main cargo hold. The conversion is so vast that only ships with massive storage capacity can even be considered for the procedure. The price is paid not in OP, but in lost cargo space..

Smuggling Compartments

By partitioning and reinforcing sections of the fuel tanks, clever engineers can create compartments shielded from most scans. You'll sacrifice long-range travel capability for the ability to transport "sensitive" goods off the books.

Turbo Drive

The Turbo Drive forces the engine far beyond safe limits, granting explosive speed and an extra Burn level. This comes at a severe cost: higher OP, increased fuel consumption, reduced weapon range, slower fighter replacement rates, and combat maneuverability penalties. Doesn't stack with Unstable Injector and offers +1 burn speed out of combat.

Advanced Armor

Advanced Armor replaces standard plating with layered, compressed dense plating, significantly reinforcing the ship's armor. This adaptive bonding process offers greater protection to lighter vessels, scaling to provide a substantial boost even to fragile frames, while also reducing explosion and kinetic damage. However, this added bulk comes at a cost. The composite's high-density mass disrupts shield harmonics and interferes with the delicate phase coil synchronization in cloaking systems. The more plating is applied to maximize protection, the greater this interference becomes, leading to a significant and variable increase in soft flux generation. Permanent installation severely hampers the ship's agility. Incompatible with Heavy Armor and Triprismatic Armor.

Triprismatic Armor

Triprismatic Armor replaces standard plating with a metallic frame overlaid by a deep, reflective polymer matrix that scatters raw energy, dispersing beams in particular. The armour's crystalline structure also tames the punishing effects of operations near coronas while also bending light and fracturing sensors, lending the ship a more subtle and stealthy signature. These exotic properties demand constant care however, raising the ship's maintenance costs to reflect this expensive armour. Permanent installation hampers the ship's agility and further increases the ship's cost. Incompatible with Heavy Armor, Advanced Armor, and Solar Shielding.

This is a balancing thing, I hope it's fun but I am not listing numbers because after testing I am probably going to want to change them, I hope they are cool and honestly I wanted to do more but I am not good with Java. I prefer *fun* over perfect balance, so I am not looking to make things that are completely foolproof.

aiDescription: Adds a variety of new hull mods that alter ship durability, crew survivability, and system trade-offs. Each mod introduces unique mechanics such as enhanced armor, emotional resonance drives, and hidden smuggling compartments. Some mods are incompatible with others, creating strategic choices during ship customization.
